_comment: Machine-readable push-log reconciliation record (Round-18, 2026-10-20). Consumed by scripts/ci/evidence_sequence_check.py --pushlog-schema --remote-slug. Classes: SUPERSEDED-BY-DOCUMENTED-REBUILD (recorded SHA verified on the remote but no longer on the branch's current lineage because the branch was rebuilt/advanced through a documented no-force-push-replacement event) and CONFIRMED-BY-LATER-EVIDENCE (intent confirmed by evidence outside the log). Every entry carries a pointer to the documenting evidence. The human-readable record is PUSH_LOG_RECONCILIATION.md in this directory; INCIDENTS.md INC-2 documents the P-015-CONFIRM collision. IDs are never reused.
